bibl.title: Note linguistiche a P. Ant. I 15 (com. adesp. fr. 1084 K.-A.).
bibl.seg: Federico Favi, Note linguistiche a P. Ant. I 15 (com. adesp. fr. 1084 K.-A.).
bibl.note: Recent scholarship has aimed at negating, on linguistic grounds, the possibility that P. Ant. I, 15 (= MP3 1320.3; LDAB 2707) may preserve a fragment of Menander. Argues that, although it cannot be regarded as entirely certain, it is very possible and indeed on balance most likely that the text is by Menander.
